newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends higher, prices still correcting.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends higher, prices still correcting.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures settled firmer for the second consecutive day in a continued technical bounce following last week's losses, market sources said.
Speculative and trade buying carried December delivery over resistance, pegged at 74.00 cents a lb. Traders are now looking at 75.00 as the next level.
Sharon Johnson, an analyst with Frank Schneider and Co Inc, said the December contract found enough support at 73.00 and is now trying to establish the highs for the week.
"We were down nearly 300 points total Thursday and Friday and we've only recovered some," she said.
December ended up 0.69 at 74.12, having ranged from 74.40 to 73.65. The back months closed 0.75 higher to 0.10 lower.
Support was seen at 70.00 in December.
